args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export missing the first week when created on run day
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Fix the weekly cadence calculation in `nextRunAt` so that a schedule created on the target day of the week schedules the first run for today (or the next occurrence) rather than skipping ahead an extra week when created after midnight or in certain time zones.
